title: Manager: fixes to the advisor left by the task 037 review
item: Fix the minor points of review 037-1 that name files on the working branch: lint rejects advisor and you together on an unmapped done_means line (or check_advice skips lines you verify); decide whether merge-limit, review and advice refusals always park instead of consulting the advisor; let consult check the condition, not only the reason label; consult's except ValueError hides a missing task file; job (d) appends to draft_note instead of overwriting it; LINE_NUMBER matches only a (n) that starts a line; SKILL.md rule 3 mentions the job (b) GO ON retry; reviewer.md Return wording for lines owned by another verifier; protect tasks/reviews/ the way tasks/advice/ is
motivation: Review 037-1 minors 1, 3 to 8 and 10, and the task 037 builder's note that tasks/reviews/ is unprotected. Minor 1 can make a task impossible to merge.
notes: Also from review 037-1, left for the owner: task 56 line 3 compares labels against checker verdicts the advisor must not see, so as written the advisor cannot rule on it; split it into labelling by the advisor and comparison by a script, or reword it, before task 56 is Ready. Also seen in this run: checks.py unmerged decides by whole files, so a finding about new code in a file that already exists on the working branch goes to a Proposed task, as all but one of 037's did; the task-49 case may have been the same. Dropped 2026-11-17 on the owner's instruction: every point is about lines task 037 added, so they went into task 037's for_retry and are fixed before it merges.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-17 from review 037-1. Priority, done_means and may_edit left for the owner; every change is under .claude/skills/manage/, which is protected.
